## {.archive-slide background-image="slides/02.webp" background-size="contain" background-color="#14140f"}

```{=html}
<div class="archive-text">Previously (February 2021 and March 2021)
• We are in the process of creating as much of the report as
possible using a synthetic data set that will mirror (in format) the
data we get from Indiana
• We are actively investigating data scenarios (e.g., low
participation) and developing processes for accommodating
• As we produce these synthetic reports we will review with IDOE
staff to add additional features as necessary so the final report
includes all necessary analyses/results.

Pandemic Related Academic Impact in Indiana 2</div>
```

## {.archive-slide background-image="slides/03.webp" background-size="contain" background-color="#14140f"}

```{=html}
<div class="archive-text">Updates
• We are currently creating historical ILEARN/ISTEP and ACCESS baseline matrices
with which to calculate baseline referenced growth from 2019 to 2021.
• We are conducting investigations using simulated historical data to understand
robustness to modelling assumptions.
• We have a report template set up and are beginning to write the introduction
and methodology sections.

Pandemic Related Academic Impact in Indiana 3</div>
```

## {.archive-slide background-image="slides/04.webp" background-size="contain" background-color="#14140f"}

```{=html}
<div class="archive-text">Data requirements (to discuss)
• ILEARN data: We have a good understanding of this data and a
process in place to get that data in a timely fashion
• ACCESS data: We have a good understanding of this data and a
process in place to get that data in a timely fashion
• Interim Assessment data: We need to discuss what this data
comprises. That will allow us to figure out what we need to run
analyses and determine whether we can get those data.
• Pandemic related data/OTL data: We need to discuss whether
Indiana has these data.
Pandemic Related Academic Impact in Indiana 4</div>
```

## {.archive-slide background-image="slides/05.webp" background-size="contain" background-color="#14140f"}

```{=html}
<div class="archive-text">Outline of Report:
Academic Related Impact of the Pandemic on Students in Indiana
• Introduction
• Background
• Methods
• Assessment data Sources (ILEARN, ACCESS, Interim Assessment Data)
• Student population in Indiana
• Overview of Indiana student population
• Who participated in each of the assessments
• Mode of education for students
• Student attendance (chronic, mostly, totally absent statistics)
• COVID-19 related closure information
• Academic Impact of the Pandemic
• Analyses of Attainment to determine academic impact
• Analyses of Growth to determine academic impact
• Synthesis of attainment and growth results
• Discussion and analysis of results
Pandemic Related Academic Impact in Indiana 5</div>
```
